workflow: supplied T13 -> source-dataset factors, graph, IF, sensitivity, read-only web app
input_source: Original T13 Parquet objects supplied by develop, downloaded through Git LFS; no regenerated people, journeys or labels

window.basis: global observed dataset dates; source completeness is unknown

forest.combination: 0.5 * IF calibration percentile + 0.5 * rules calibration percentile; separate experimental score
forest.scope: Retrospective unsupervised anomaly detection; scoring all supplied profiles, not future prediction
forest.split: sha256(person_id) first 32 bits mod 10: 0–5 train, 6–7 calibration, 8–9 holdout

graph.limitation: Repeated observed co-occurrence; not calibrated significance. M07 does not add a ranking vote.

repeatability: Second identical scripts/run_t17.py -q verified and reused the completed snapshot
packaging: Wheel built successfully; all six static assets included
